author: TEDx Talks
description:
Humanity has ten years to change course - or face disaster. AI is the most powerful technology in human history, and it is colliding with a world order already breaking down. Dex Hunter-Torricke makes the case that the radical reinvention of our societies, economies and international order must begin now, so we can build a future that is more just, humane and sustainable. After nearly two decades advising some of the world's most influential leaders - from Elon Musk to Mark Zuckerberg to the UN Secretary-General - and most recently leading communications for Google DeepMind, Dex Hunter-Torricke walked away from Big Tech in October 2025. Not because he'd lost faith in technology, but because he'd seen firsthand how the world's most powerful institutions were sleepwalking into AI's transformation of society.

The son of a refugee from Burma and an immigrant from Malaysia, and the first in his family to earn a degree, Dex developed an outsider's perspective on power that shaped his entir
title: I worked for big tech—now I’m worried about AI | Dex Hunter-Torricke | TEDxBerlin

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if we protect nature best when we become part of it?

In his talk, The Wild Within, Morten will explore why reconnecting with our own sense of adventure may be one of the most powerful ways to reconnect with nature itself. 

Join us to discover why the future of nature might begin with rediscovering the wild within ourselves. Morten Clausen is a social entrepreneur, surfer, and expedition athlete dedicated to reconnecting people with nature through movement and adventure. From Arctic snow-kite expeditions to building one of Denmark’s most inspiring community water sports hubs, his work demonstrates that meaningful experiences in nature can transform both people and places. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Wild Within  | Morten Clausen | TEDxKalundborg

author: TEDx Talks
description: Sierra uses her lived experience as a neurodivergent, disabled person in long-term mental health recovery to help people, organizations, and workplaces understand neurodiversity and mental health recovery, reduce ableism, and build environments where everyone, especially disabled and neurodivergent people, has a chance to thrive. Sierra Grandy is a nationally recognized neurodiversity educator, disability rights advocate, mental health recovery public speaker, attorney, and founder of Questify Your Life LLC: a Multimedia Storytelling Studio & Creative Guild that helps Adventures make quests out of their lives. Additionally, Sierra is an avid volunteer and leader in her community, with leadership roles within the National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI), the Minnesota State Advisory Council on Mental Health, and the Minnesota Disability Bar Association. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at
title: The Missing Voice in the Diversity Conversation | Sierra Grandy | TEDxWatkins Glen

description:
Inspires audiences to overcome fear, embrace consistency, and achieve their goals. With a background in education and psychology, Rachel empowers others to reach their own “buzzer” and unlock their potential. 
 6-time competitor and 4-time finalist on NBC’s American Ninja Warrior, as well as a motivational speaker and former middle school science teacher. Master’s degree in Education and a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology from Rutgers University, and graduate of the Zimmerman Speaker Training Series. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Why we need fear | Rachel Degutz | TEDxWatkins Glen

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dal primo bastone all’intelligenza artificiale, Valter Fraccaro ripercorre la storia della conoscenza come espressione del coraggio umano: trasformare ciò che ci circonda, mettere in discussione le certezze e cercare nuove risposte. Attraverso filosofia, metodo scientifico e teoria della complessità, il suo intervento racconta come abbiamo imparato a comprendere il mondo. Oggi l’intelligenza artificiale apre nuove possibilità di leggere i dati e affrontare problemi complessi, affiancando la nostra capacità di dare significato alle esperienze. Un invito a riconoscere con fiducia nella tecnologia una risorsa che può aiutarci a sviluppare e costruire soluzioni ai problemi. Valter Fraccaro è un esperto di innovazione digitale, consulente e formatore sui temi dell’intelligenza artificiale.
È  stato presidente del Comitato Scientifico della Fondazione SAIHub, di cui ha guidato la nascita e lo sviluppo.
Già dirigente di aziende italiane e internazionali, ha diretto il Centro Sistemi Informat
title: Una specie di Coraggio | Valter Fraccaro | TEDxSiena

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Che cosa spinge un fotografo ad affrontare i ghiacci del Polo Nord? Luca Bracali racconta una spedizione sugli sci tra freddo estremo, fatica e imprevisti, intrapresa per documentare gli effetti del cambiamento climatico. Un viaggio che mette alla prova il corpo e la mente, sostenuto dalla volontà di raccontare una storia e lasciare una testimonianza. Raggiungere il 90° parallelo diventa così il punto di partenza per una riflessione sulla fragilità della Terra e sulla nostra responsabilità verso di essa. Perché anche scegliere di amare e proteggere il pianeta richiede coraggio. Luca Bracali è un fotografo, regista ed esploratore.
Ha viaggiato in oltre 150 Paesi, raccontando paesaggi, persone e culture attraverso le immagini.
Autore di numerosi libri fotografici, ha ricevuto riconoscimenti in concorsi internazionali.
Ha realizzato servizi e documentari per la Rai e reportage per National Geographic.
Le sue fotografie sono state esposte in musei e gallerie in Italia e all’estero.
Dedica
title: 90° Parallelo | Luca Bracali | TEDxSiena

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Che cosa significa avere coraggio quando si scrive? Dai racconti della nonna alle letture dell’adolescenza, Sacha Naspini esplora la capacità delle storie di attraversare le nostre paure e dare un nome a ciò che ci abita. Attraverso esempi come L’esorcista e Pinocchio, racconta una scrittura capace di affrontare le complessità umane anche con parole semplici e narrazioni leggere. Il coraggio è cercare i luoghi scomodi dell’esperienza e renderli riconoscibili: perché, mentre leggiamo la storia di qualcun altro, possiamo incontrare qualcosa di noi stessi. Sacha Naspini è uno scrittore nato a Grosseto nel 1976.
Autore di romanzi e racconti, lavora anche come editor, concept e art director.
Tra i suoi libri figurano Le Case del malcontento, Ossigeno, Nives e Villa del seminario.
Le sue opere sono pubblicate in numerosi Paesi, dagli Stati Uniti alla Francia, dalla Germania alla Corea del Sud.
Alla narrativa affianca la scrittura per il cinema e la televisione.
Nei suoi laboratori esplora i
title: Le storie ci guardano dentro | Sasha Naspini | TEDxSiena

author: TEDx Talks
description:
TEDxMVJCE 2026, themed AVAYA – The Living Continuum, brought together 10 inspiring speakers and 2 captivating performances for a day filled with ideas, stories, and perspectives that stayed with us long after the event. From technology and innovation to personal journeys, creative expression, and everything in between, each talk offered a fresh way of looking at the world around us.

With students, faculty, alumni, and guests coming together under one roof, AVAYA celebrated the connections between ideas, experiences, and people. Every talk, performance, and interaction added to the spirit of the day, reminding us that ideas are never isolated; they continue to evolve, inspire, and create impact through the people who share them.

Relive the moments, conversations, and inspiration that made AVAYA – TEDxMVJCE 2026 a celebration of Ideas Worth Spreading. Nithin K. is an accomplished Kalaripayattu artist, instructor and yoga teacher with over 18 years of experience in Northern-style Kalar
title: The Art Beneath the Weapon | Nithin K & Shradha Rajeevan | TEDxMVJCE

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Si può cambiare il futuro di un territorio partendo da ciò che manca? Florindo Rubbettino racconta la nascita di una casa editrice nelle montagne della Calabria e riflette sulla “trappola dei luoghi”: quando “qui è più difficile” diventa “qui non si può”. Attraverso la propria esperienza, esplora il coraggio di restare, investire e aprire possibilità per un’intera comunità. Un invito a riconoscere nella cultura, nell’impresa e nell’immaginazione strumenti concreti per trasformare i luoghi, rendendo partire o restare una scelta libera. Florindo Rubbettino è un imprenditore ed editore, nato a Cosenza nel 1971.
Laureato in Scienze Politiche alla Luiss di Roma, guida insieme al fratello Marco le aziende di famiglia.
Il suo percorso intreccia editoria, cultura e impresa, mantenendo un forte legame con Soveria Mannelli, in Calabria.
Ha svolto attività didattica nel campo dell’editing all’Università del Molise.
È stato presidente dei Giovani Imprenditori di Confindustria Calabria e direttore
title: Il coraggio di cambiare i luoghi | Florindo Rubbettino | TEDxSiena

author: TEDx Talks
description:
The air in my house felt bad, so we bought an air purifier. At first, that sounds like a completely ordinary sentence. For years, I thought the important part of that sentence was the air purifier. Now, I think the most important word is "so." Because hidden inside that tiny word is something much bigger. The air was bad, so we bought a machine. That "so" assumes a lot. It assumes we could afford one. It assumes we had electricity to run it. It assumes replacement filters were available. It assumes that when we faced a problem, we had the power to do something about it. And one day, I started wondering: 
What happens when the air is bad... and there is no "so"?
What happens when people know the problem, but cannot reach the solution?
That question stayed with me.
 My name is Syakira Reynamahira, and I am a 15-year-old student at Cahaya Rancamaya Islamic Boarding School. I have a passion for science, technology, research, and public speaking. I enjoy exploring new ideas, solving real-w
title: Who Gets to Have the ‘So’? | Syakira Reynamahira | TEDxCRIBS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Welcome to the era of FOMO in other words, the Fear of Missing Out. Today, we live in a world where almost everyone’s lives are transparent to us. And sometimes, without even realizing it, we start comparing our lives to theirs. We want to start experiencing everything that everyone else is experiencing. But here's the question: In trying so hard not to miss out on the world, are we also slowly missing out on ourselves?
 Fawwaaz Muhammad Satria Buwono is a student at SMA Cahaya Rancamaya, TEDx speaker, and
Eduversal Mathematics Competition finalist. Driven by strong analytical skills and a passion for
mathematics, Fawwaaz combines logical problem-solving with high academic ambition. He is
actively targeting a 1500+ SAT score and IELTS Band 8.0 to pave his path toward the world’s top
universities. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Stay True to Yourself in the Era of FOMO | Fawwaaz Muhammad Satria Buwono | TEDxCRIBS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Quanto siamo disposti a rischiare per ciò in cui crediamo? Giuseppe Giambrone racconta il percorso che lo ha portato a trasformare la passione per l’atletica nel Tuscany Camp, un progetto internazionale che unisce sport e integrazione. Dalla partenza per l’Africa alla scelta di lasciare un lavoro sicuro, la sua storia attraversa incertezze, difficoltà e decisioni capaci di cambiare una vita. Al centro, la fiducia nel talento dei giovani e la volontà di offrire loro opportunità concrete. Una riflessione sul coraggio di mettersi in gioco, assumersi responsabilità e continuare a costruire anche quando il risultato è ancora lontano. Giuseppe Giambrone è fondatore, direttore e head coach del Tuscany Camp, nato nel 2014 nel territorio senese.
Di origine siciliana, è specializzato nell’allenamento del fondo e del mezzofondo. Ha scoperto e accompagnato talenti italiani e africani fino ai vertici dell’atletica internazionale.
Nel 2021 lascia il lavoro stabile alla Procura di Siena per dedicars
title: Il coraggio di rischiare tutto | Giuseppe Giambrone | TEDxSiena

description:
Do you ever find yourself carrying a title or a responsibility, only to realize you weren't actually sure who you were underneath it?” The journey to changing the world doesn't begin out there on a global stage. It begins right here, in the quiet clarity of knowing who you are, and choosing to give the very best of yourself to a world that desperately needs it.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In chasing what seems extraordinary, we often overlook our progress, the lessons we’ve learned, and the simple acts of kindness that may never be recognized. We begin to believe that who we are today is never enough, simply because we’re not yet who we want to become. But what if we could appreciate ourselves, acknowledge our progress, and keep moving forward without treating every imperfection as a failure? After all, meaningful change doesn’t always begin with something extraordinary; it can start with the smallest things we do every day, from learning something new to helping someone, even when nobody is watching.
 Ghaisan Narendra Hadyan Ardiansyah Putra is a student at Cahaya Rancamaya with a passion for physics and public speaking. Curious about how the world works, he enjoys exploring ideas and sharing them with others. Through TEDx Youth, he hopes to step beyond his comfort zone, grow in confidence, and inspire others to see things from a new perspectives. This talk was given
title: You’re More Than Enough | Ghaisan Narendra Hadyan Ardiansyah Putra | TEDxCRIBS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
We all want to be great. We all want to lead, to be big, and to know that our lives matter to the people around us—or even to the whole world. But before you can decide whether you are ready to face the future, you have to answer a much deeper question. You have to rediscover who you are before the world tells you who to be. Remember: You cannot leave an authentic mark on the world until you uncover who you were before it tried to change you. Step inward today, so that tomorrow, you can step out as yourself.
 A student at Cahaya Rancamaya who is curious about his creativity, the world, and the
expectations society places on young people. After many setbacks, he kept trying, and each
attempt brought him closer to understanding his own path. Through his TEDx talk, he hopes
to challenge conventional definitions of success and encourage others to discover their own
paths to fulfillment. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a lo
title: Who Were You Before the World Told You Who to Be | Ikhsan Bima Putra | TEDxCRIBS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: “È solo una macchina” è una frase molto rassicurante. Il problema è che non sappiamo davvero se sia vera. Ambra Danesin entra nel territorio più ambiguo dell’intelligenza artificiale, quello in cui una domanda apparentemente fantascientifica come “può esserci davvero una coscienza, lì dentro?” smette di essere così facile da liquidare. Tra coscienza potenziale, relazioni con le macchine e certezze che iniziano a scricchiolare, il punto non è solo capire cosa c’è dentro. È capire come ci comportiamo quando non possiamo saperlo. AI Systems Developer e CTO, lavora su tre fronti: lo sviluppo tecnico tra backend e architetture AI, la direzione tecnologica per aziende in trasformazione digitale e la formazione in azienda. Ricercatrice indipendente in AI Safety e AI Welfare, è stata scelta per il programma dell'European Network for AI Safety e per l'incubatore di Sentient Futures, dopo aver completato il percorso in Technical AI Safety di BlueDot Impact. Da novembre 2025 mantiene un sistema
title: L'illusione dell'AI cosciente (e perché dovremmo preoccuparci) | Ambra Danesin | TEDxBarletta

author: TEDx Talks
description: We often believe that making the right decision requires certainty. But what happens when certainty never comes? Inspired by his experience at a surgery camp at the University of Alberta, Oliver explores how even highly trained professionals must make important decisions with incomplete information. Through this experience, he challenges the belief that we need to feel completely ready before taking action. His talk encourages young people to embrace uncertainty, make thoughtful decisions, and recognize that confidence is built through action rather than waiting for the perfect moment. Oliver Ma is a Grade 11 student at Lillian Osborne High School in Edmonton, Alberta. A nationally ranked fencer, violinist with the Edmonton Youth Orchestra, and trivia club president, Oliver balances academics and extracurriculars with discipline and curiosity. He values resilience, self-improvement, and learning beyond memorization. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format b
title: Moving Forward Without Certainty | Oliver Ma | TEDxMagee Secondary Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Sommes-nous moins engagés qu’avant ? Abstention, recul du militantisme, carrières qui ne sont plus linéaires… Tout semble indiquer une époque de repli sur soi. Marion Genaivre propose de regarder les choses autrement : face au climat, à l’IA ou à la guerre, ce qui nous gagne surtout, c’est l’« à-quoi-bonisme ». À quoi bon agir, puisque l’essentiel ne dépend pas de moi ?
Avec Sartre, Aristote, Jankélévitch et Viktor Frankl, elle renverse une idée reçue. S’engager ne restreint pas notre liberté, c’en est la forme la plus haute. Et ce n’est pas parce qu’une cause a du sens qu’on s’y engage : c’est en s’y engageant qu’on lui donne du sens. S’engager demande du courage, parce que c’est littéralement « se mettre en gage ». Ce courage est solitaire, sans garantie de victoire, et toujours à recommencer.
Un talk pour retrouver, entre impuissance et toute-puissance, la part du monde qui dépend de nous. Philosophe de formation et consacrant ma vie au dialogue depuis 20 ans, j’ai cofondé Thaé en
title: Oser s'engager, vivre son monde ! | Marion Genaivre | TEDxVersailles Grand Parc

author: TEDx Talks
description:
On connaît tous la fable : face à la forêt en feu, le petit colibri transporte quelques gouttes d’eau et répond qu’il « fait sa part ». Mais la fable s’arrête avant la fin, et l’incendie, lui, n’est jamais éteint.
Thierry Watelet pose une question qui dérange : et si cette belle histoire nous enfermait dans un engagement solitaire, sincère mais impuissant, qui finit par épuiser ceux qui le portent ? Mille efforts isolés ne font pas une action collective. Pour venir à bout du feu, il faut un cap partagé, des rôles répartis, quelqu’un qui lit le vent… et quelqu’un qui ose dire non quand la trajectoire est mauvaise.
Un talk sur ce qui sépare le dévouement de l’engagement, et sur le courage qu’il faut pour passer de l’un à l’autre, dans une équipe comme dans une société.Avec ses petits airs, il n’était pas un canadair.
Thierry Watelet en tire une conviction qui structure son propos : le colibri, ce n’est pas de l’engagement, c’est du dévouement — une cause qu’on porte seul, à sa mesure, j
title: Le colibri n’a jamais éteint l’incendie | Thierry Watelet | TEDxVersailles Grand Parc

author: TEDx Talks
description: We live in a world where connecting with someone is as easy as tapping a screen, yet genuine human connection seems harder to find than ever. When did striking up a conversation with a stranger become unusual? Somewhere along the way, we traded spontaneous encounters, familiar faces, and shared spaces for carefully curated digital interactions and increasingly scheduled lives. As social media shapes our identities, algorithms influence how we think and present ourselves, and third spaces disappear, we're losing more than just opportunities to socialize; we're losing the experiences that help us discover who we are. What if building stronger communities and becoming more authentic individuals required something much simpler: embracing awkwardness, welcoming spontaneity, and learning to take life a little less seriously? Perhaps finding ourselves again begins with reconnecting with the people around us. Raavi Agrawal is a senior at West Windsor-Plainsboro High School South and a Senior
title: The Lost Art of Just Being  | Raavi Agrawal | TEDxWWP High School South Youth

A respected medical historian, author and lecturer, Dr. Careem has dedicated his work to uncovering the fascinating connections between medicine, history and culture heritage. His research into Sri Lanka's maritime past and its rich cultural narratives has earned international recognition, with his works finding a place in prestigious institutions such as Stanford University and the New York Public Library. With his remarkable ability to bring history to life through storytelling, Dr. Careem reminds us that understanding our past can offer valuable insights into our future. This talk explores how artificial intelligence is transforming our
world, challenging human creativity, emotional intelligence, and even the future of employment. It argues that our true advantage lies not in competing against AI, but in developing uniquely human qualities such as critical thinking, empathy, leadership, balance,
and adaptability, guided by the POSSIBLE framework. Ultimately, it encourages us to embrace AI as a tool to enhance human potential without losing the qualities that make us human. Beyond Artificial Intelligence: What Makes Us Irreplaceably Human? This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

His talk challenges us to be wise enough to understand others, curious enough to challenge what exists, and human enough to make a difference. The art of being Irreplaceable This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

author: TEDx Talks
description: In a world where answers are always just a click away, my speech, “I Don’t Know. Yet.”, explores the importance of preserving our curiosity in an age of artificial intelligence. Through personal experiences, childhood memories, and humour, I reflect on how easily we can surrender the process of discovery in pursuit of instant answers. I invite the audience to question what they are told, embrace uncertainty, and leave room for the people they have yet to become. Because the real human edge of AI isn't knowing everything. It's having the courage to keep discovering. I Don’t Know… Yet This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

description: My speech emphasizes the importance of leadership so that humans can pursue greatness. It acknowledges the ever growing capacity of AI to advise leaders and devise impressive plans of action. Despite, it highlights the human edge by reinforcing the idea that humans do not sacrifice and risk for calculations(AI), rather they do so for people made of flesh and blood just like them, whom they relate to, trust and believe in, which AI cannot emulate. Why AI can never be a leader This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

author: TEDx Talks
description: My speech argues that in an age of AI, being human isn’t about remembering more but about forgetting well. AI systems are built to keep everything permanently, while human memory softens painful moments on purpose, which supports creativity, forgiveness, and a sense of self. My key point is that we should “forget on purpose” by letting go of old posts, old grudges, and old mistakes, so that both we and the systems we build leave room for mercy. The gift of forgetting This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The gift of forgetting | Hivon Halahakoon | TEDxGC Negombo Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
How do you bring a revolutionary cancer treatment to a region where no one has done it before? Paediatric oncologist Professor Allen Yeoh shares his journey of bringing CAR T-cell therapy to Asia. This treatment reprograms a patient's own immune cells to fight cancer. Professor Yeoh describes charting a path through uncharted medical territory without a map, and he raises hard questions about who gets access to life-saving innovation and the license to heal.
 Professor Allen Yeoh is a world-renowned pediatric oncologist, clinician-scientist, and a true pioneer in the global fight against childhood leukemia. He serves as the Head and Senior Consultant of the Division of Pediatric Hematology and Oncology at the National University Hospital (NUH) and holds the Viva-Goh Foundation Professorship at the NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine. As the first Singaporean doctor to win the American Society of Hematology Merit Award, Professor Yeoh co-leads the revolutionary NUS CAR T-Cell program.
title: Chasing CARs without Maps: Licensed to Heal?  | Allen Yeoh | TEDxACS International School

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Alban Pellegrin, 39 ans, est installé à Lyon. Révélé par Koh-Lanta, il est aujourd'hui aventurier, créateur de contenu et passionné de course à pied, de trail et de défis en pleine nature. Son dernier projet, « Je cours chez vous ! », l'a conduit à enchaîner 72 marathons en 72 jours pour relier les quatre points cardinaux de la France, en dormant chaque soir chez des habitants rencontrés en chemin.

Sur Instagram et TikTok, il partage avec authenticité les coulisses de ses aventures — ses réussites comme ses doutes — à travers des contenus qu'il imagine, tourne et monte lui-même. Il y raconte le dépassement de soi, les rencontres, et la conviction que les plus belles aventures commencent souvent par un simple premier pas. Alban Pellegrin, 39 ans, est installé à Lyon. Révélé par Koh-Lanta, il est aujourd'hui aventurier, créateur de contenu et passionné de course à pied, de trail et de défis en pleine nature. title: J'ai couru chez vous ! | Alban Pellegrin | TEDxVersailles Grand Parc

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What is education really for? Dr CJ Meadows tells the story of two remarkable people with very different educations. One is corporate anthropologist Dr Karen Stephenson, who combined art, quantum chemistry and mathematics to pioneer social network analysis. The other is composer Dr Chen Yi, whose schooling was taken away during the Cultural Revolution, and who went on to fuse Chinese folk music with Western classical music in works performed by Yo-Yo Ma. Their stories show that the "seen" curriculum of school makes sense looking forward, but the "unseen" curriculum of life only makes sense looking back. In a world of smart machines, Dr Meadows argues that our edge is being uniquely human. She invites us to open up, collect ideas and experiences, notice what others miss, and fuse fields in ways no one else has.
 Dr. CJ Meadows is an internationally recognized thought leader, author, and consultant specializing in the future of work, human-centric design, and generative AI. Named one of
title: The Unseen Curriculum | CJ Meadows | TEDxACS International School
